description: A spectrum display that folds the frequency axis round a twelve-tone circle, with the six strongest peaks carried out as pitches and levels

params.text: Sets the colour the display is drawn in, -5V to 5V around the hue wheel
Attenuverts the hue CV before it is added to the hue knob
Sets how solidly the shape is filled in, -5V to 5V
Attenuverts the fill CV before it is added to the fill knob
Sets how far the drawing is bent into petals, -5V to 5V
Attenuverts the flower CV before it is added to the flower knob
Scales the analysis before it is drawn, which brings out quiet partials or holds back loud ones, -5V to 5V
Attenuverts the analysis CV before it is added to the intensity knob

inputs.text: The signal whose spectrum is measured and drawn
Changes the drawing colour, scaled by a tenth and added to the hue knob through its attenuverter
Changes how solidly the shape is filled, scaled by a tenth and added to the fill knob through its attenuverter
Changes how far the drawing is bent into petals, added to the flower knob through its attenuverter and clamped to the knob's travel
Changes the analysis scaling, scaled by a tenth and added to the intensity knob through its attenuverter

outputs.text: Carries the six strongest peaks of the spectrum as six polyphonic channels of volt per octave, strongest first, with 440Hz at 0.75V
Carries the level of each of those six peaks as six polyphonic channels, 0-10V, in the same order as the pitch output

notes: the module makes no sound and changes nothing that passes through it; it measures the signal at the input and draws it
menu: Flower Mode — draws the spectrum as a twelve-petal polar figure, one petal per semitone
Waterfall Mode — draws the spectrum as a scrolling history instead of a polar figure
Scope Mode — draws the waveform itself instead of its spectrum
